name: Opto-Electronic Detectors and Image Sensors
description: Fundamentals of opto-electronic image sensors, Physics, device fabrication, electronic circuits, noise sources and signal processing of: Photo detectors based on PMT, MCP : UV-Visible photo detectors, VIS-NIR Photo detectors, IR-FIR detectors, THz-detectors, Charged coupled Devices (CCD) based image sensors. Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) based image sensors. Thermal imaging camera and sensor technology, FLIR, FPA, Single photon detectors and quantum detectors, Ultra-high speed photo-detectors: TCSPC, Ultra-high speed electronic streak camera, Ultra-high speed Framing camera, Electronic circuitry for ultra-high speed camera technology, Signal and image processing tools and techniques.
